name: Campers Cove
why: No nightly rate anywhere, read 2026-10-30: the operator's 2014 Wix site (thecovekeylargo.com: 32 sites, adults only, 'stay the night, or a year', phone 305-451-0561) posts no price, and its Reservations page promises a redirect to an online booking site but carries no booking link or engine (browser-rendered); its contact email domain camperscovekeylargo.com is a parked domain (Wayback shows parking scripts since 2020); Campendium's Last Nightly Rate is blank; RV Life avg_rate 0 (placeholder). Google Maps (4.8/8, no phone) is short of the 25-review presence bar. It also looks residential: Campendium flags full-time residents and mobile homes, MHVillage lists it as Camper's Cove Mobile Home Park, and a 1994 manufactured home at 101644 Overseas Hwy unit #12 was listed for sale ($100,000, MLS A11704394), so long-stay tests 2 and 5 would also be in doubt.

name: Captain Jax RV Resort and Marina
kind_of_no: duplicate of Kings Kamp (one operation); own lots are a mobile-home community with no posted nightly rate
why: kingskamp.com/captain-jax/ (read 2026-10-30): 'Captain Jax is located right next door to Kings Kamp RV park. We offer 55 sites, Marina and boat ramp', with Kings Kamp's phone 305-451-0010 and email and no rate or booking of its own. The joint map (KK-CJ-Map PDF) splits the property with a line into two lot series, 1-55 north (Captain Jax) and 1-60 south (Kings Kamp), around one shared office, and the 2026 joint rules head both addresses (103620/103650). Kings Kamp's rate table covers only its own lots 1-60. MHVillage lists Captain Jax Trailer Resort as a 24-site mobile home park, and an active MLS listing (A12015690) sells a 1981 mobile home in 'Captain Jax Mobile' with association approval and the land not conveying. 2024-11 orthophoto shows the north half mostly roofed-over mobile homes. The RV nights sold here are Kings Kamp's, already in results/kings-kamp.json.

name: America Outdoors Camper Resort and Marina
why: rvparking.com lists America Outdoors Camper Resort & Marina at 97450 Overseas Hwy as CLOSED and RV Life marks it Permanently Closed; that address is now Playa Largo Resort & Spa (Marriott Autograph Collection, opened 2016, marriott.com), and Esri imagery at the RV Life pin 25.07408,-80.465 (read 2026-10-30) shows hotel buildings, pools and a beach, no RV pads. Checked 2026-10-30.

name: Blue Fin Rock Harbor Marina & RV Resort
why: Operator site rvkeylargo.com/rv-sites (read 2026-10-30): 37 RV sites (13 oceanfront, 2 semi-oceanfront, 22 non-waterfront) but 'Please contact us for our seasonal rates' with no posted nightly rate and no booking engine (every 'Book now' leads to an inquiry form to fill in before phoning); it also states a standing '3 night minimum stay', and the home page markets long-term/winter-season (2026-27) sites. Fails the price-and-presence rule and long-stay test 3.

name: Calusa Campground Resort & Marina
kind_of_no: owner-lot condo with no booking site (owner rentals / phone only)
why: Read 2026-10-30: the association's own site calusacampground.com (a Conduu condo-owner portal: About Us, Map, Amenities, Contact, owner login) calls Calusa Campground Condominium Association, Inc. 'a residential community comprised of 367 units' ('some units are land only others house recreational vehicles and residential homes') and has no rates, reservations page or booking engine, only an office phone (305-451-0232 ext. 101) and a contact form; RV Life lists no booking link (book_now_active false) and Good Sam gives no website; the RoverPass listing is unclaimed (isBookable false, API read 2026-10-30); no Campspot/Firefly/Newbook/Staylist listing found; the nights on sale online are individual owners' units and lots (Booking.com/Expedia/VRBO/Airbnb park models and RVs, and an owner's Hipcamp lot 'The Little Mermaid', not accepting bookings). Under AWH's owner-lot rule (2026-10-30) nights sold only by owners or by phone/email inquiry are a skip.

name: Pelican Cay RV Park
why: No nightly rate dated 2024 or later anywhere, read 2026-10-30: the operator domain pelicancayrvpark.com is hijacked (Indian rummy/teen-patti gambling spam; Wayback shows the takeover from April 2026, and only bot-blocked 403s 2022-2025); the RoverPass listing (Pelican Cay Harbor Camping & Marina, updated 11/15/2024) is unclaimed with no rates and no booking button; the only rate anywhere is a $56 RV Life review from 1/2021. It also looks like a long-stay park: a 12/2021 RV Life reviewer was told it accepts only applications from long-term residents (long-stay test 2), and a 2020 manufactured home at the park's own address (299 Morris Ave, 'Monroe Park' subdivision, $1,400 association fee covering utilities, MLS A12083237) is listed for sale at $59,000 (test 5).

name: Point Of View Key Largo RV Resort
why: Redeveloped as a hotel, read 2026-10-30: RV Life marks it 'Permanently Closed' (newest reviews 2016-17); Cheeca Holdings bought the 110-site bayfront park at 99010 Overseas Hwy in Dec 2015 to build a resort (hotel-online.com / therealdeal.com 2016); bungalowskeylargo.com now gives 99010 Overseas Highway as the address of Bungalows Key Largo, an all-inclusive resort opened 2019; Esri satellite at the RV Life pin 25.08944,-80.44668 (rendered, read) shows rows of identical bungalow roofs, pools and a beach club, with no RV pads.
